titles.native: カゲロウデイズ-in a days-

description:
UltraCeep Inc. and Aniplex will launch a collaborative project to produce a theatrical anime titled MX4D Kagerou Daze -in a days-, based on JIN's Kagerou Daze light novel series. The production claims the anime is the first "short movie" in Japan to be produced exclusively with MX4D presentation in mind.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
